message: The other day, I was cooking dinner when my phone decided it was the perfect moment to die on me. Of course, that’s when I remembered I hadn’t checked the smoke alarm in a while. Luckily, I had a backup plan—an old-school timer and a good sense of smell! It reminded me how important it is to have those safety checks in place, just in case technology decides to take a nap. Have you ever had a tech fail at a crucial moment?
